title: judge_plan keeps a constraint line's paths in the log
intention: A plan line judge_plan judges a constraint keeps its writes_to and reads in the ticket log (kind field, field constraint_paths, value {n, writes_to, reads}), and the three tickets that already lost them are re-filled from the plan at each judge commit's parent.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: judge_plan turned constraint lines into bare strings and logged their paths nowhere. 149b9a1ab9c4, 044020db63c0 and 95557c2ed44f lost 84 writes_to and 85 reads paths over 9 lines; the writes survived only in bounds.in, the reads nowhere, and 149b's proof read the emptied plan and sealed red. The orchestrator, 2026-11-16: 'agreed, all four in that order... if nothing reads those fields, the re-fill can land with (1)'.
traces_to: Law 7: a plan is a record of truth, and a path dropped from it is lost silently. Law 5: the log keeps what the plan no longer carries.
how: judge() collects {n, writes_to, reads} for each line judged a constraint that names any path; apply() logs each through ticket_log.append_log after the falsifier line, before rewrite_ticket. The re-fill reads each ticket's plan at its judge commit's parent (e3d18386, 0b001d69, 211dfce0) and appends the same line for every constraint line that named a path, skipping any n already logged.

clauses.claim: a line naming writes_to or reads judged a constraint leaves exactly one log line, kind field, field constraint_paths, value {n, writes_to, reads} equal to the line's, and its text joins constraints verbatim
a constraint line naming no paths logs no constraint_paths line, and a refused packet writes nothing
149b9a1ab9c4, 044020db63c0 and 95557c2ed44f each carry constraint_paths lines, and every path in each one's bounds.in is named by an outcome's writes_to or a constraint_paths line

decisions.text: D1: judge() collects the paths of each pathful constraint line and returns them as constraint_paths; apply() logs each as a field line.
D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause; clauses 1-2 in a scratch commons as the 4d8a2c6e91f7 proof builds it, clause 3 reads the live commons beside the checkout.
D3: the re-fill, run once from wt-jp/cairn through ticket_log.append_log, writes 9 lines into the three tickets' .log.jsonl in the commons; it lands in the commons commit beside this build.

out: the 7 tickets whose bounds.in proof path no outcome names (a cast-time gap)
